_about.source: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
_about.note: Control titles are quoted verbatim. The mapping from a CodeSentinel class to a control is our judgement, not a NIST publication - it is stated as 'relates to' for that reason. SP 800-53 controls are organisational and system-level; a single line of code implements part of one, it does not satisfy one.

CS001.title: Authenticator Management
CS001.summary: Manage system authenticators by verifying the identity of the individual, group, role, service, or device receiving the authenticator; establishing initial authenticator content; and protecting authenticator content from unauthorized disclosure and modification.

CS002.title: Information Input Validation
CS002.summary: Check the validity of system inputs for defined information inputs.

CS003.title: Information Input Validation
CS003.summary: Check the validity of system inputs for defined information inputs.

CS004.title: Cryptographic Protection
CS004.summary: Determine the cryptographic uses and implement the types of cryptography required for each use.

CS005.title: Access Enforcement
CS005.summary: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

CS006.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
CS006.summary: Establish a process or processes to identify and address weaknesses or deficiencies in the supply chain elements and processes.

CS007.title: Information Input Validation
CS007.summary: Check the validity of system inputs for defined information inputs.

CS008.title: Access Enforcement
CS008.summary: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

CS009.title: Configuration Settings
CS009.summary: Establish and document configuration settings for components employed within the system that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements.

CS010.title: Session Authenticity
CS010.summary: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

CS011.title: Denial-of-Service Protection
CS011.summary: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service events.

CS012.title: Information Input Validation
CS012.summary: Check the validity of system inputs for defined information inputs.

CS013.title: Security Function Isolation
CS013.summary: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

CS014.title: Information Input Validation
CS014.summary: Check the validity of system inputs for defined information inputs.

CS015.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
CS015.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

CS016.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
CS016.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

CS017.title: Protection of Audit Information
CS017.summary: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.
